task: Make an mtgui window with a progress bar that starts empty, a label under it that says 0% done, and a Step button. Each click fills the bar 10 more, but never past full (100), and the label shows the same amount, like 30% done.
solution:
mention mtgui

app = mtgui.window("Progress", 360, 220)
done = 0
bar = app:progress(0)
info = app:text "0% done"
app:button("Step", step, "primary")

func step():
    done = min(done + 10, 100)
    bar:set(done)
    info:set text(done) + "% done"

Make an mtgui stopwatch. A heading shows the time in seconds with one decimal place, starting at 0.0. A Start button starts it counting up in tenths of a second (0.1, 0.2 and so on, so 12 seconds shows 12.0), and while it runs that same button says Stop; clicking Stop pauses it and the button says Start again. A Reset button stops it and puts the time back to 0.0.
solution:
mention mtgui

app = mtgui.window("Stopwatch", 360, 240)
running = false
tenths = 0
shown = app:heading "0.0"
controls = app:row
go_btn = controls:button("Start", start_stop, "primary")
controls:button("Reset", reset_watch, "ghost")
app:every(0.1, tick)

func show_time():
    shown:set text(floor(tenths / 10)) + "." + text(tenths % 10)

func start_stop():
    running = not running
    if running:
        go_btn:set "Stop"
    else:
        go_btn:set "Start"

func tick():
    if not running:
        return
    tenths += 1
    show_time()

func reset_watch():
    running = false
    tenths = 0
    go_btn:set "Start"
    show_time()

task: Make an mtgui temperature converter. It has a text box with the hint Degrees Celsius, a Convert button and a result label. Convert shows the temperature in Fahrenheit (Celsius times 9, divided by 5, plus 32) rounded to one decimal place, followed by a space and F, like 98.6 F. If the box doesn't hold a number, the label says Please type a number in red instead; a good answer is shown in the normal color. Pressing Enter in the box does the same as clicking Convert.
solution:
mention mtgui

app = mtgui.window("Converter", 380, 280)
app:heading "C to F"
celsius = app:input "Degrees Celsius"
app:button("Convert", convert, "primary")
result = app:text ""
celsius:enter convert

func looks_like_number(t):
    ln_digits = 0
    ln_dots = 0
    ln_at = 0
    for ln_ch in t:
        if "0123456789":has(ln_ch):
            ln_digits += 1
        elif ln_ch is ".":
            ln_dots += 1
        elif ln_ch is not "-" or ln_at > 0:
            return false
        ln_at += 1
    return ln_digits > 0 and ln_dots < 2

func convert():
    typed = celsius:value():trim()
    if not looks_like_number(typed):
        result:set "Please type a number"
        result:color "red"
        return
    fahrenheit = number(typed) * 9 / 5 + 32
    result:set text(round(fahrenheit, 1)) + " F"
    result:color "text"

task: Make an mtgui tip calculator. It has a text box with the hint Bill amount, and under it a slider for the tip percent that goes from 0 to 30 and starts at 15. Just above the slider, a label always shows the slider's current value, like Tip: 15%, and changes as soon as the slider is dragged. A Work it out button puts Total: $ followed by the bill plus the tip in a result label at the bottom, always with two decimal places (like Total: $23.00 or Total: $8.05). If the bill isn't a number, the result label says Type a number instead.
solution:
mention mtgui

app = mtgui.window("Tip calculator", 380, 360)
app:heading "Tip calculator"
bill = app:input "Bill amount"
tip_label = app:text "Tip: 15%"
tip_slider = app:slider(0, 30)
tip_slider:set 15
app:button("Work it out", work_out, "primary")
total_label = app:text ""
tip_slider:change tip_moved

func tip_moved(pct):
    tip_label:set "Tip: " + pct + "%"

func is_amount(t):
    ia_digits = 0
    ia_dots = 0
    for ia_ch in t:
        if "0123456789":has(ia_ch):
            ia_digits += 1
        elif ia_ch is ".":
            ia_dots += 1
        else:
            return false
    return ia_digits > 0 and ia_dots < 2

func dollars(amount):
    dl_cents = floor(round(amount * 100, 6) + 0.5)
    dl_rest = dl_cents % 100
    dl_text = "$" + text(floor(dl_cents / 100)) + "."
    if dl_rest < 10:
        dl_text += "0"
    return dl_text + text(dl_rest)

func work_out():
    typed = bill:value():trim()
    if not is_amount(typed):
        total_label:set "Type a number"
        return
    cost = number(typed)
    with_tip = cost + cost * tip_slider:value() / 100
    total_label:set "Total: " + dollars(with_tip)

The Question page shows What is the capital of France? with three answer buttons side by side: Berlin, Paris and Rome. Clicking any answer goes to a Result page that says Correct! for Paris, or Wrong, it is Paris. for the other two, and has a Play again button that goes back to the Start page.

start_page:heading "Capital Quiz"
start_page:button("Start", go_question, "primary")
question_page = app:page "Question"

task: Make an mtgui number guessing game. The computer picks a secret whole number from 1 to 20. There is a text box with the hint Your guess, a Guess button, a New game button and a label. Clicking Guess (or pressing Enter in the box) shows Too low!, Too high! or Got it in N tries! (N is how many guesses it took), and empties the box. If the box doesn't hold a whole number, show Type a whole number and don't count it as a try. Once the number is guessed, the Guess button is switched off and further guesses are ignored. New game picks a new secret, sets the tries back to 0, empties the label and switches Guess back on.
solution:
mention mtgui

app = mtgui.window("Guess", 380, 300)
secret = random(1, 20)
tries = 0
won = false
app:heading "Guess 1 to 20"
guess_box = app:input "Your guess"
controls = app:row
guess_btn = controls:button("Guess", guess, "primary")
controls:button("New game", new_game, "ghost")
feedback = app:text ""
guess_box:enter guess

func whole_number(t):
    if len(t) is 0:
        return false
    for wn_ch in t:
        if not "0123456789":has(wn_ch):
            return false
    return true

func guess():
    if won:
        return
    typed = guess_box:value():trim()
    guess_box:clear
    if not whole_number(typed):
        feedback:set "Type a whole number"
        return
    tries += 1
    tried = number(typed)
    if tried < secret:
        feedback:set "Too low!"
    elif tried > secret:
        feedback:set "Too high!"
    else:
        feedback:set "Got it in " + tries + " tries!"
        guess_btn:disable
        won = true

func new_game():
    secret = random(1, 20)
    tries = 0
    won = false
    feedback:set ""
    guess_btn:enable
    guess_box:focus

task: Make an mtgui 2-minute timer. A heading shows the time left as minutes:seconds, starting at 2:00 and counting down one second at a time (1:59, 1:58 and so on, with 0:09 for nine seconds), and a progress bar under it fills up as time passes, so it is full at 0:00. A Start button starts or pauses the countdown, and its text says Start or Pause to match. When the time reaches 0:00 the countdown stops and a label says Time is up! in red. A Reset button puts everything back to how it started.
solution:
mention mtgui

app = mtgui.window("Timer", 380, 300)
full_time = 120
left = 120
running = false
face = app:heading "2:00"
bar = app:progress(0)
controls = app:row
start_btn = controls:button("Start", start_pause, "primary")
controls:button("Reset", reset_timer, "ghost")
done_label = app:text ""
app:every(1, tick)

func time_text(secs):
    tt_min = floor(secs / 60)
    tt_sec = secs % 60
    if tt_sec < 10:
        return text(tt_min) + ":0" + text(tt_sec)
    return text(tt_min) + ":" + text(tt_sec)

func refresh():
    face:set time_text(left)
    bar:set((full_time - left) / full_time * 100)

func start_pause():
    if left is 0:
        return
    running = not running
    if running:
        start_btn:set "Pause"
    else:
        start_btn:set "Start"

func tick():
    if not running:
        return
    left -= 1
    refresh()
    if left is 0:
        running = false
        start_btn:set "Start"
        done_label:set "Time is up!"
        done_label:color "red"

func reset_timer():
    running = false
    left = full_time
    start_btn:set "Start"
    done_label:set ""
    done_label:color "text"
    refresh()
